decisions.reason: The lesson-value criterion is independent of narrative completeness and is already fully represented by its own message-84 MODIFY.
Narrative completeness does not alter source-selection rules; the one-video constraint from message 84 is already represented separately.
Requiring a complete beginning-to-end moment does not change the existing 20-to-120-second duration limits.
Message 84 does not change the existing requirement to select moments with good hooks.
Visual editing style is independent of narrative completeness and its message-84 changes are already fully represented by a separate MODIFY.
The source completeness standard does not change batch delivery state, and the eight-clip trial was already established before message 84.
The complete-moment requirement does not modify the existing caption color treatment.
Following examples and guidelines does not explicitly establish or modify a caption-font requirement in this source decision.
The completeness standard does not change the existing target of 180 approved clips per month; message 84 only reiterates that target.
